scope: macOS arm64 FreeCAD 1.1.3; finite tested configurations; constant-section stock; Windows, physical cuts and whole-machine 4 GB qualification deferred
status_policy: Only final packaged real-GUI runs with independent output evidence can pass E00-E32. Unit/oracle tests are supporting evidence, not GUI passes. E18 explicitly uses native-boundary evidence for repeated-tool orders that the generator cannot emit; this does not replace its GUI cap-state journeys.

cases.journey: Install the final archive in a clean profile, launch CAM, open Create Inlay from its native entry, cancel, reopen, and switch workbenches/documents.
cases.independent_assertion: One command/panel exists; viewport and selection remain usable; package imports come from the installed archive; no personal settings or unrelated document change.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Run the entire import-to-export sequence for each required tool-set family, including asymmetric artwork and native save/reopen.
cases.independent_assertion: Independent cutter/assembly oracles and parsed exported motions agree with the final accepted design and setup; both native jobs are retained as evidence.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Import paths, primitives, nested transforms, filled compounds, holes/counters, outlined text, supported inherited fill properties, and mixed units through the file control.
cases.independent_assertion: Known analytic topology, physical extents, hole count, orientation, and retained source IDs match the visible imported result.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Import malformed, self-intersecting or ambiguous, stroke-only, raster, live-text, unsupported-effect, and mixed-content fixtures; attempt external references.
cases.independent_assertion: Exact affected regions/reasons are visible; supported content remains selectable; no silent tracing, stroke expansion, remote load, or application of unresolved input occurs.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Create small and 24-inch slabs; edit dimensions; select valid existing planar faces and invalid/nonplanar or deleted references.
cases.independent_assertion: Native stock sizes and selected face transforms match inputs; invalid selection is recoverable; no arbitrary extra size limit or stale face is accepted.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.
cases.qualification: Existing face capture is limited to constant-thickness prisms. Irregular outlines and through holes are tested; taper and hidden recess are rejected.

cases.journey: Switch displayed metric/imperial units and mix the representative imperial cutters with metric cutters and stock dimensions.
cases.independent_assertion: Independent quantity conversion preserves physical size, cutter identity, fit, feeds, depth, and resolution through save and native export.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Center on X, Y, and both; resize, rotate, drag, use numeric placement and bounds; change each setup origin independently.
cases.independent_assertion: Artwork scale/assembly registration stays paired; slab-axis centering matches expected coordinates; moving artwork does not silently move the work origin.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Preview flipped asymmetric artwork and outlined letters; create another face-pair task; alternate documents and selections.
cases.independent_assertion: Explicit rigid transforms produce the correct assembled orientation; each task owns only its pair and operations; origins and other tasks remain unchanged.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Move details across each rectangular edge; vary margins; include a tool whose center fits but swept cutter/plug relief does not.
cases.independent_assertion: Cuttable/blocked overlays agree with independently intersected bounds and actual swept material; blocked included portions prevent Apply.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Zoom, select regions and portions near holes/thin features, exclude them, restore them, and reject an invalid retained topology.
cases.independent_assertion: Both halves change together, valid holes/components remain correct, source artwork survives, and visibility never substitutes for exclusion.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Browse/select/deselect native flat, V, and bull-nose tools; try an unsupported or incomplete definition; select two distinct physical tools of equal diameter.
cases.independent_assertion: Geometry and identities match snapshots; required missing data is diagnosed; source library hashes remain unchanged; equal diameter does not merge tool identities.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Calculate straight corners, finite-tip V details, bull floor/crown/root cases, overreach, and an intentionally incompatible root clearance.
cases.independent_assertion: Independent profiles/sweeps certify positive fixtures and identify precise blocked regions in negative fixtures; no V/bull result is silently treated as a flat end mill.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Edit a tool's maximum stepdown and pass spacing, override one operation, and compare other uses on both faces.
cases.independent_assertion: Emitted depth/pass intervals respect effective values; only the intended use changes; inherited versus overridden settings and the unchanged library are visible.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Set different cutting, plunge, feed-controlled travel, and spindle values for roughing/finishing and both faces; retain the same physical cutter.
cases.independent_assertion: Independently parsed native/exported F/S values and unit conversions match effective settings; overrides do not introduce a false physical tool change.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Drive D, switch to H without changing geometry, then vary glue gap, per-side clearance, and backing clearance separately, including infeasible combinations.
cases.independent_assertion: Independent section/reference equations and local clearance intervals agree; inputs are not silently clamped or coupled; nominated pose and first contact remain distinct.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Change shared XY and independent Z increments, shift artwork relative to the lattice, and exercise narrow features and near-zero clearances.
cases.independent_assertion: Final restored/exported motion respects the configured contract; numerical uncertainty is separate from commanded changes; unresolved residuals/fit violations prevent Apply.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Preview a rounded proposal, reject it, accept it for the pair, change a cutter, and inspect the newly proposed revision.
cases.independent_assertion: Source-versus-result differences are independently measurable; only explicit acceptance changes retained geometry; prior acceptance cannot authorize a new revision.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Select paths in the list and viewport; isolate/hide/show; switch board, plug, assembled sections, and expected finished-board views.
cases.independent_assertion: Selected cutter/face/path agree; cutting/travel and inclusion/visibility states differ correctly; displayed material/depth samples agree with the verifier; no backing-removal path exists.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Enable/disable each cap independently; test below/at/above limits, same-tool speed changes, and three operations per face with a cap of four. Challenge repeated A→B→A ordering at the native validation boundary: the current generator emits one operation per selected cutter, so that repeated order is not a reachable generation action.
cases.independent_assertion: Counts match independently read operation order; no initial-load or cross-face change is counted; no pooling, silent tool removal, or hidden work bypasses a conflict.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.
cases.route_note: Repeated A→A→B→A order is an ordered native adapter fixture, not a generated GUI plan. The GUI exercises reachable tool order and cap states; independent native/export counters challenge repeated identities.
cases.qualification: Repeated A→A→B→A order is covered by the native adapter fixture. The generator emits one operation per selected cutter per face; its reachable GUI cap states are independently tested.

cases.journey: Recalculate with changed speeds and a selected detail cutter; inspect each operation's baseline and chosen candidate.
cases.independent_assertion: Independent length/feed timing confirms the selected valid candidate is no slower than its baseline; no selected fidelity is discarded; manual changes and workshop tasks stay excluded.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Calculate, edit a machining input while reviewing, request another calculation, cancel a running calculation, and retry.
cases.independent_assertion: Input/result hashes and visible state transitions agree; stale results cannot Apply; prior accepted native work survives; repeated actions do not create duplicate workers or jobs.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Inspect the full final review, cancel it, confirm a valid pair, and attempt Apply with a stale/blocked revision or count conflict.
cases.independent_assertion: No jobs appear before confirmation; a valid Apply writes exactly the reviewed pair; invalid attempts make no document change; no export is triggered by Apply.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Undo/redo a successful pair, then inject failure after creating the first job while an unrelated job already exists.
cases.independent_assertion: Native document snapshots show atomic pair creation/removal and complete rollback; unrelated geometry/jobs and earlier accepted paths remain intact.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Open built-in Custom editing, change a command/feed, reorder/manage operations, recompute, save, and reopen.
cases.independent_assertion: Independent native-command comparison shows durable intended edits; controller-feed changes do not falsely imply rewriting stored F words; the original certificate is not claimed for modified motion.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.
cases.qualification: Native commands remain editable without the extension. Six-decimal native feed rounding is reported independently; manual edits invalidate the prior geometry certificate. Unsuitable export options are detected by test oracles, not blocked by an extension exporter.

cases.journey: Save, close, remove the add-on from the test profile, make the original SVG/tool library unavailable, and reopen in a fresh Mac process.
cases.independent_assertion: Actual native GUI inspection, durable editing, recompute, resave, and ordinary CAM export succeed without extension imports or external source dependencies.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.
cases.qualification: Native commands remain editable without the extension. Six-decimal native feed rounding is reported independently; manual edits invalidate the prior geometry certificate. Unsuitable export options are detected by test oracles, not blocked by an extension exporter.

cases.journey: If shipped, restore saved planning state, change settings, detect prior manual CAM edits, cancel replacement, then explicitly replace.
cases.independent_assertion: Restored exclusions/modifications/limits match source records; no automatic mutation occurs on reopen; cancellation preserves manual edits and replacement remains atomic. If absent, mark optional/unimplemented explicitly.
cases.remaining: Optional planning-task restoration is not shipped. Native CAM output is retained and editable without the add-on.

cases.journey: Select each reviewed native Job and use the actual CAM postprocessing command/dialog with the qualified LinuxCNC settings.
cases.independent_assertion: A separate parser reconstructs modal units, origins, F/S, tool order, G61, and motion; independent sweep/assembly checks apply to the exported commands, not just planner memory.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Save/reload near-rounding-boundary coordinates; export fine metric/inch cases and deliberately unsuitable post precision or unrestricted G64.
cases.independent_assertion: The harness detects lost precision or uncertified motion mode and records its cause; a qualified native settings route succeeds without modifying the postprocessor or adding an exporter.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.
cases.qualification: Native commands remain editable without the extension. Six-decimal native feed rounding is reported independently; manual edits invalidate the prior geometry certificate. Unsuitable export options are detected by test oracles, not blocked by an extension exporter.

cases.journey: Inject worker startup failure, crash, unavailable private dependency, interrupted result writing, timeout, and memory pressure during actual GUI calculation.
cases.independent_assertion: A useful error/progress outcome appears; Cancel/retry remain usable; stale/partial results cannot Apply; previous accepted work and recoverable draft inputs remain intact.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Cancel input/save dialogs; use paths with spaces/non-ASCII characters; simulate missing/read-only input/output/cache and mismatched result versions/hashes.
cases.independent_assertion: No shell interpretation or unrelated-file deletion occurs; errors identify the action; no partial result replaces accepted output; retry with a valid location succeeds.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Run packaged journeys offline, then the six-family/large-stock/dense qualification corpus with external process-tree monitoring.
cases.independent_assertion: No runtime account/download is needed; memory/preview caches meet recorded budgets; responsive progress/cancellation and recoverable exhaustion are observed; no whole-machine 4 GiB claim is inferred.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.
cases.qualification: Offline execution, process budgets and recoverable dense-case rejection are tested. This is not qualification of a complete 4 GB computer.

cases.journey: Cold-install, replace with another verified package, roll back the test installation, uninstall, and reopen saved native output.
cases.independent_assertion: Installed manifest/import origins match the tested archive; no checkout dependency or unrelated preferences change; rollback restores the previous package and removal leaves native output usable.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.

cases.journey: Use the panel at representative window sizes, operate keyboard/native selection controls, switch active documents during review, and repeat task entry.
cases.independent_assertion: Required labels/settings/actions remain reachable; zoom and selection work; document context is correct; repeated entry leaves no duplicate commands, leaked overlays, or stale references.
cases.remaining: No remaining Mac software gate within the recorded finite acceptance scope; see explicit qualifications.
